featured_reviews.name: Mrs. Reshma Swett
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is about my experience at their WorkShop Location :
Opp. Shivaji Nagar Police Station in Bandra East

bad experience :
I came in after reading the other positive reviews here  with great hopes , ended up feeling like I walked into a scammed dealership 😅

And the narcissism ? my god ...
Asked for a simple change ? “ Madam , that’s not in our policy . ”
Wanted to know delivery time ? “It’ll come when it comes , we’re busy . ” . Seriously — they act like they’re doing you a favor by letting you buy from them .

Red Flags :
- pushy sales tactics ( they will insert wrong & expensive versions you didn’t ask for )
- zero honesty - once we finalizzed a piece at a certain rate in the purcahse order , the prices in the invoice were raised without mutual agreement . when we confronted ,
- No Apology , No Refund , No “sorry we messed up”
instead they blamed the colleagues misunderstanding and challenged our memory .
- Pathetic Customer Service 🙃

Final Verdict :
If you’re okay with being talked down to , charged extra for inhaling air in their outlet and pick your delivery cause it is important for you — then yeah , go ahead .
Otherwise … run . Run fast and find a real gifting shop . Maybe one that doesn’t make you feel like you owe them money for stepping into their den .

Disclaimer : This is my real experience . Not all customers may have the same issues . But still… y’all stay warned . 😎
